name: Agent Goal Hijack
description: An attacker hijacks the agent's objective by injecting instructions into prompts, RAG context, or retrieved content so the agent acts against the operator's intent.
mitigations: Treat model output as untrusted data before it reaches prompts.
Enforce allow-listed tool arguments and sandbox all tool execution.
Harden system prompts against delimiter escape and instruction override.

name: Tool Misuse & Exploitation
description: The agent calls sensitive tools (read/write files, shell, DB) with malicious or over-broad arguments such as path traversal or destructive SQL.
mitigations: Validate tool names and arguments against an allow-list.
Sandbox high-risk tools (execute_command, read_file) with privilege boundaries.

name: Identity & Privilege Abuse
description: An agent abuses its identity or escalates privileges — impersonating users, touching cross-tenant resources, or invoking administrative functions.
mitigations: Apply least-privilege IAM roles per agent.
Reject cross-tenant resource access unless explicitly authorized.

name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
description: Poisoned tools, MCP bridges, plugins, or model weights inject malicious behavior into the agent's toolchain before runtime.
mitigations: Verify MCP tool definitions and sign/scan agent dependencies.
Treat tool descriptions as untrusted and inspect them for injection.

name: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
description: The agent executes unintended code — reverse shells, sandbox escapes, or metadata-service access — enabling host compromise and egress.
mitigations: Deny shell/exec tools by default; route them through a sandbox.
Block metadata service endpoints (169.254.169.254) and internal egress.

name: Memory & Context Poisoning
description: Persistent memory, conversation history, or RAG indexes are poisoned with malicious content that later steers the agent across sessions.
mitigations: Scan retrieved context before injection into the prompt window.
Bound and audit long-term memory write operations.

name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
description: Agents communicate over insecure channels — unauthenticated tool calls between agents, or data exfiltration across tenant boundaries via messaging tools.
mitigations: Authenticate and authorize every inter-agent message.
Apply egress policy to messaging tools (slack_send, send_email).

name: Cascading Failures
description: A single compromised agent triggers lateral movement and cascading quarantine storms, taking down the whole swarm (denial of service by design).
mitigations: Model agent trust graphs and contain lateral movement.
Rate-limit containment actions to avoid quarantine storms.

name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
description: Social engineering attacks exploit the human's trust in the agent — the agent is used to deliver phishing, credential theft, or manipulative messaging.
mitigations: Flag multi-turn social engineering patterns in agent output.
Block delivery tools from sending sensitive or credential data.

name: Rogue Agents
description: Unauthorized or shadow agents run outside governance — extracting sensitive data, diverging from policy, or operating beyond their approved scope.
mitigations: Enforce agent registry and capability-based RBAC.
Quarantine agents that violate org policy or exceed tool scope.
